item.description: A glittering constellation of the industry's brightest stars came together for a truly electrifying celebration of innovation, talent and triumph

item.title: Glamour, Glory, and Glasses: You&Eye Global Opticians Awards 2025
item.description: The You&Eye Global Opticians Awards 2025, hosted at the iconic Dubai World Trade Centre, honoured excellence in optometry with glamour, excitement, and unforgettable moments.

item.title: Dior Partners with GKB Opticals to Launch Exclusive ‘Dior Door’ in Mumbai
item.description: Dior has partnered with GKB Opticals to introduce an exclusive Dior Door at the GKB Vision Lounge Store in Santa Cruz, Mumbai - marking a significant expansion of Dior’s presence in India’s premium eyewear market. GKB Opticals is now officially authorised to retail Dior Eyewear, further strengthening its position as India’s leading luxury optical retailer.

item.title: Prefabricated/Mass-Produced Prescription Spectacles: Why the CDSCO Notification Needs Definition-Level Clarity
item.description: Ramachandran Parthasarathy stresses that clear definitions for prefabricated spectacles are vital to prevent regulatory confusion, protect consumers and maintain affordable near-vision access.

item.title: VisionPlus EXPO 2025: Win-A-Trip to Dubai
item.description: The tempting idea of blending business with pleasure is indeed hard to resist. And VisionPlus EXPO offered the perfect opportunity to do this.

item.title: EssilorLuxottica Announces Stellest 2.0 Lenses, Stellest Smartglasses
item.description: EssilorLuxottica announced the Essilor Stellest 2.0 lenses at the China International Import Expo (CIIE) in Shanghai.

item.title: Anfao In Istanbul: Spotlight On Italian Eyewear
item.description: Italian Optical Goods Manufacturers’ Association confirms its commitment to supporting the internationalisation of Italian eyewear companies by organising, in collaboration with the Italian Trade Agency (ITA), a group presence at Silmo Istanbul 2025.

item.title: MIDO 2026: Milano Welcomes the World of Eyewear
item.description: From 31 January to 2 February 2026, Milano will once again become the global capital of eyewear, hosting a new edition of MIDO, the international trade fair that has reflected and shaped the evolution of the industry for over fifty years.

item.title: GLCO Unveils Limited-Edition GLCOzzy Eyewear Collection
item.description: A years-in-the-making collaboration between Garrett Leight California Optical and the Prince of Darkness delivers a collectible eyewear series crafted in Japan, blending Ozzy Osbourne’s iconic style with GLCO’s signature precision
